info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Loan Application Collaterals API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of collaterals associated with loan applications. By utilizing this endpoint, users can update the details of specific collaterals within a loan application. Typical consumers of this API include loan officers and financial institutions looking to efficiently maintain accurate collateral records. This operation is crucial for ensuring that loan applications reflect the most current information about collateral values and types, thus supporting informed lending decisions.

put.summary: Update collateral for a specific loan application.
put.description: This operation allows you to update the collateral details associated with loan application RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully update the collateral.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the collateral information for the specified loan application. The data provided will modify the existing collateral records associated with the loan application ID RES-100045.

200.description: Request completed successfully, collateral information updated.
